title: llm-usage-metrics report output: shared definitions (v1)
description: Shared definitions for the schemaVersion 1 report JSON envelope and token-bucket shapes.

tokenBuckets.description: The six token buckets every usage-bearing row carries.

inputTokens.description: Prompt tokens sent to the model.

outputTokens.description: Completion tokens returned by the model.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning/thinking tokens, when the source reports them.

cacheReadTokens.description: Tokens served from a provider prompt cache.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Tokens written into a provider prompt cache.

totalTokens.description: Total tokens for the row as reported or derived.

usageTotals.description: Token buckets plus optional cost fields.

costUsd.description: Resolved cost in USD; omitted when no pricing resolved.

costIncomplete.description: True when some events in the row lack resolved pricing.

envelope.description: The versioned envelope wrapping every report's --json output.

schemaVersion.description: Breaking-change version of the report JSON contract.

report.description: The report name that produced this payload.
